name: Agent Identity & Authentication
description: Verifies agent presents valid credentials for every action. No anonymous tool calls.
threat_addressed: Agents operating without verified identity cannot be held accountable. Unauthorized agents can access tools and data without attribution, making incident investigation and compliance demonstration impossible.
enforcement_mechanism: Every agent action must include a verified identity token. Actions without valid identity are blocked (enforce) or flagged (audit). Identity verified against registered agent credentials.

security_outcome.pass: Agent identity verified for this action.
security_outcome.fail: Agent identity missing or invalid for this action.

display_detail: Verifies the agent presents valid credentials for every tool call. Prevents anonymous or unauthorized actions.
remediation_hint_template: Agent identity could not be verified. Ensure agent.name in ancilis.yaml matches the agent making tool calls.
